summary: A 30-foot pole L-4 tower and log cabin built in 1934 in the Kootenai National Forest; destroyed in 1958, and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 30-foot pole L-4 tower with a log cabin for living quarters
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1958; no source describes the site today.

events.note: 30-foot pole L-4 tower with a log cabin; built together

evidence.supports: Kootenai National Forest, 12 miles WSW of Yaak, Lincoln County, elevation 6,226 feet
evidence.quote: Kootenai National Forest 12 miles WSW of Yaak Lincoln County, Montana Elevation 6226'

evidence.supports: 30-foot pole L-4 tower with log cabin, built in 1934, destroyed in 1958
evidence.quote: This 30' pole L-4 tower and accompanying log cabin living quarters, built in 1934, were destroyed in 1958.

evidence.supports: Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the tower as gone

notes_for_editor: Build year 1934 and destruction year 1958 rest on one enthusiast site (firelookout.com). The FFLA list says only Tower Gone and gives no NHLR or FFLOS number. Two web searches found no other account, and no cause of destruction. The Yaak Mountain lookout is a different tower, so do not conflate the two. Record kind tower and the coordinates match both sources. No staffing, access or visit facts found.
